question.prompt: Name a science-fiction franchise set in space.
question.criteria: Any science-fiction franchise with multiple released works in which outer-space travel or life beyond Earth is a major part of the setting.

answers.evidence: Star Wars is a science-fiction franchise featuring interstellar adventures in a galaxy far, far away.
Star Trek follows starship crews exploring space and encountering alien civilizations.
Alien is a science-fiction horror franchise involving extraterrestrial creatures, spacecraft and off-world colonies.
Dune is a science-fiction franchise centered on rival powers in an interstellar civilization.
Halo is a science-fiction franchise depicting conflicts involving humanity and alien civilizations across space.
Mass Effect is a science-fiction game franchise set among the civilizations of the Milky Way.
Stargate is a science-fiction franchise about travel between worlds through ancient portals.
Battlestar Galactica follows human survivors traveling through space while pursued by the Cylons.
The Expanse is a novel and television franchise set in a future where humanity has colonized the Solar System.
Warhammer 40,000 is a science-fiction franchise set amid warfare across the galaxy.
Babylon 5 is a science-fiction franchise centered on a space station used by multiple civilizations.
Farscape follows a human astronaut traveling with alien companions aboard a living spaceship.
Red Dwarf is a science-fiction comedy franchise following the inhabitants of a mining spaceship.
Foundation is a science-fiction book and television franchise set within a galaxy-spanning civilization.
Gundam is an anime-led franchise whose settings frequently feature space colonies and warfare using giant robots.
Macross is a science-fiction anime franchise featuring transforming aircraft, alien civilizations and space travel.
Homeworld is a science-fiction strategy game franchise centered on fleets of spacecraft.
Guardians of the Galaxy follows a team of adventurers traveling through space in Marvel comics and films.
Firefly follows a spaceship crew whose adventures continue in the film Serenity and other works.
Dead Space is a science-fiction horror franchise set aboard spacecraft and in off-world settlements.
Space Battleship Yamato is an anime franchise about a spacefaring battleship and its crew.
Space Quest is a comedic science-fiction adventure game series following space janitor Roger Wilco.

answers.canonical: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy
answers.evidence: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy is a comic science-fiction franchise about travels through space.
Lensman is a space-opera franchise originating in E. E. Smith's stories about an interstellar struggle.

question.explanation: Space-based science fiction spans films, television, books, anime and games. Answers can feature anything from interstellar exploration to space warfare, alien encounters or life aboard a spaceship.

provenance.brief: Name a science-fiction franchise set in space.

Star Trek.reason: Multiple television series and films feature starships, space exploration, and alien civilizations.

Alien.reason: Multiple films and other works prominently feature spacecraft, alien life, and off-world colonies.

Dune.reason: Multiple novels and adaptations depict an interstellar civilization and conflicts across planets.

Halo.reason: Multiple games and other works feature space travel and conflicts between human and alien civilizations.

Mass Effect.reason: A multi-game science-fiction franchise centered on interstellar travel and galactic civilizations.

Stargate.reason: Films and multiple television series feature travel to other planets and life beyond Earth.

Battlestar Galactica.reason: Multiple television productions depict human survivors traveling through space aboard a fleet.

The Expanse.reason: A novel series and television adaptation prominently feature space travel and settlements throughout the Solar System.

Warhammer 40,000.reason: A multimedia science-fiction franchise featuring interstellar civilizations and galaxy-wide warfare.

Babylon 5.reason: A television franchise with films and a spin-off, centered on a space station and interstellar affairs.

Farscape.reason: A television series, sequel miniseries, and comics follow adventures aboard an alien spaceship.

Red Dwarf.reason: Multiple television series and novels follow characters living and traveling aboard spacecraft.

Foundation.reason: Multiple novels and a television adaptation depict a galaxy-spanning human civilization.

Gundam.reason: Numerous released series and films prominently feature space colonies, spacecraft, and space warfare.

Macross.reason: Multiple anime series and films feature alien civilizations, space travel, and interstellar settlement.

Homeworld.reason: A released strategy-game series centered on spacecraft fleets and interstellar journeys.

Guardians of the Galaxy.reason: Multiple comics and films feature a spacefaring team and adventures beyond Earth.

Firefly.reason: The television series, Serenity film, and additional works follow a spaceship crew traveling among settled worlds.

Dead Space.reason: Multiple games and related works feature spacecraft, extraterrestrial settings, and off-world settlements.

Space Battleship Yamato.reason: Multiple anime series and films follow a battleship undertaking voyages through space.

Space Quest.reason: A multi-game science-fiction adventure series featuring Roger Wilco's travels through space.

The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy.reason: Radio, novels, television, and film depict comedic journeys across space.

Lensman.reason: E. E. Smith's multi-book space-opera series and its adaptations feature interstellar civilizations and conflict.
